messages:
emma: Heads up — running the synthetic long-context suite w/ the new paging patch. Seeing steady memory growth once KV size > ~3.2GB, after ~120k tokens. Attaching quick log excerpt.

sahil: Can you paste the repro command + config?

emma: repro command:
```
./bench/harness --suite long_tail_stream --model rwd-13b --seq 262144 --clients 8 --kv-cache-max 4g --eviction-policy lru
```
log tail:
```
[00:12:34] kv_cache: allocated 3.1G
[00:12:50] kv_cache: paging triggered, freed 32MB
[00:13:12] kv_cache: rss +120MB
```

morgan: Interesting — profiler (perf + heaptrack) shows a lot of small live allocations from KV reuse paths. Suspect fragmentation: many 4k/64k chunks not coalescing. Also eviction path touches pages frequently. I can share flame snippet.

morgan: flame excerpt:
```
kv_reuse_loop 40%
kv_alloc_slab 25%
pager_mark_dirty 15%
gc_coalesce 5%
```

bench-bot: perf-run complete: throughput 120 tok/s, p95 latency 320ms, mem_end 3.34G, mem_peak 3.56G. Regression vs baseline: +18% mem_peak. Full CSV: https://bench.internal/xyz

emma: Thanks — hypothesis: our current eviction candidate selection favors LRU without considering contiguousness, leading to fragmentation and higher RSS. Proposed regression test: long_tail_fragmentation with simulated interleaved short/long requests to force reuse pattern. Params: sequences [4k, 64k, 128k], mix 70/20/10, runtime 10m. Expected failure criteria: mem_growth_rate > 5MB/min or mem_peak > baseline*1.1

sahil: Can automate in CI? Add to nightly perf gate + add an assertion to detect >10% regression over baseline. Also add telemetry: fragmentation_ratio (num_free_extents / total_extents).

emma: I'll open a PR with the test + telemetry + a repro script. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4287

morgan: I'll add a small change to the pager to prefer coalescing free ranges before eviction. Will run locally.

emma: Plan: land test first, then pager patch. If test reproduces, roll forward. Tagging @sahil for CI quota changes. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: created perf ticket PERF-8732 for long-tail kv regression
